plainSummary: CLI and MCP perform the same verified work loop and reject unauthorized or stale changes without repeating uncertain operations.
summary: Scoped independent review of Use CLI and MCP for the same work. Inspected the actual fixed-root stdio executable, shared schema and operation dispatch, source and permission guards, immutable request receipts and CLI review path. Independently ran 24 passing tests: ten application boundary killers, six receipt crash/concurrency/retry killers, three actual CLI/MCP lifecycle and negative-parity cases, packed MCP installation/execution, two real saved-check output cases, and two CLI/MCP library retry boundaries. The real executable lifecycle reaches verified completion in disposable repositories; negative cases preserve domain state and share structured errors. No production changes were needed, and this approval is based on freshly run behavior rather than a prior review pointer.
